text: And Elisha{H477} the prophet{H5030} called{H7121} one{H259} of the sons{H1121} of the prophets,{H5030} and said{H559} unto him, Gird up{H2296} thy loins,{H4975} and take{H3947} this vial{H6378} of oil{H8081} in thy hand,{H3027} and go{H3212} to Ramoth-gilead.{H7433}
